removed.description: taken off the map (a tombstone: the id stays reserved, the history stays)

name.description: `{ de, en }`, more languages as keys; missing → the source language (de)

x.description: the place's ground point, world units

toons.description: the toons whose story uses the place (the builder's "used by", the reader's per-toon view)

hidden.description: hidden until the story's `unlockLocation` event unlocks it – default: visible from the start (owner 2026-10-11: places are unlocked by events only; the old slice / chapter link `unlock` went with migration 2026-10-11-unlock-location-events)

chapter.description: the chapter the place's card links to

size.description: its diorama's width in world units – how much of the map's hex grid it takes (`placeSize`, `placeCells`)

view.description: how the reader's map frames the place when it centres on it (owner 2026-10-10: "pro Location einen Zoom festlegen … als Mittelpunkt die Location selber, gegebenenfalls noch mit einem Offset"; set in the map builder). Without it: the place's point at `PLACE_ZOOM` (`placeView`).

gates.description: where routes enter and leave the place's diorama (owner 2026-10-12, BACKLOG 10.66 (4), variant A "gates"): a route stops at the entry and goes on from the exit – nothing is drawn across the place. Offsets from the place's point in world units, on the place's own hexagons; each one missing = computed (`placeGate`: the place's hexagon nearest the neighbouring waypoint)

LocaleText.description: Text per locale: `{ de: "Kostüm", en: "Costume Design" }`.

size.description: drawn width in screen px at zoom 1 (default 48); the image keeps its ratio

anchor.description: the point inside the image, % of its box, that sits on the place's (x, y) – the centre of its hex cells (default 50 / 50: the diorama centred on its honeycomb patch – owner 2026-10-11, "alle zentrieren, nicht am Boden")

plaster.description: the same diorama as the unpainted plaster model (owner 2026-10-11: "zwei Zustände – als Gipsmodell und als bemaltes fertiges Diorama"): the unlock reveal fades from it to the painted `src` (agents/MAP.md §8.5a). CDN-root path, the same framing as `src` (size and ground point are shared)

variants.description: the sizes of `src` for the screen's density (owner 2026-10-11: "Locations in 1x 2x 3x – 256 512 1024"): `low` 1x, `medium` 2x, `high` 3x – the same shape as a slice's `imageVariants`; none = `src` alone

plasterVariants.description: the same for the plaster model

QualityVariants.description: One file per quality level (CDN paths like `src`); a missing level falls back (`pickQualityVariant`).

zoom.description: the zoom when the map centres on the place, `MAP_MIN_ZOOM`..`MAP_MAX_ZOOM` (default `PLACE_ZOOM` – owner 2026-10-11: "kleiner geht schon")

offset.description: the view centre's shift from the place's point, world units (default none: the place itself is the centre)

PlaceView.description: A place's own framing on the reader's map (agents/MAP.md §8.4)

PlaceGates.description: A place's route gates (`MapPlace.gates`): offsets from its point, world units

handle.description: the route's control point at the gate, an offset from the gate (world units) – how the line runs in or out of the place; missing = computed (`gateHandle`: perpendicular to the place's nearest outer hexagon edge, `ROUTE_HANDLE` long)

PlaceGate.description: One gate: its offset from the place's point, and its Bézier handle (owner 2026-10-12)
